title: A Bridge that Leads to an Oasis

text_block_list.text:
One day,
while I was walking around Tracen…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fuwaaaa～

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yup, bullseye. I feel like a worm that's 
shriveled up on the side of the road.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well,
we're prepping our new journey:
the Twinkle Series,
so it can't be helped… Maybe those youngsters
will entertain me～

…She was a girl who acted like anywhere
under the sky was her home.
School life definitely must feel like a
cramped cage to her.

A place that's not too far away from here,
but also satisfies her desire to travel…
Realistically speaking,
a place like that doesn't—
A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Yeah, unfortunately. 
Why, what's up?
choice_data_list: Shall we go on a small journey?
Shall we go on a small journey?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh～, this is… that Uma-lator, right? 
It has to be.
choice_data_list: Yup, we're going on a virtual jour...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…So that's how it is.
It'd be impossible to do it in real life so
we take it to a fake one. Haha,
now that's interesting! Alright,
let's give it a whirl!
(Vrrrrrrrr)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Whew. 
Now this is impressive.
choice_data_list: [Is your body okay? Do you have yo...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a-okay over here. 
But wow…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I really can smells things in here. 
Fresh and sweet, the smell of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is this flower a mix of a marguerite and a
poppy? 
Either way it's a pretty flower.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Hey! 
Can I walk as much as I'd like?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright! 
I've been waiting to hear those words!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
the leaves changed colors as soon as I
started walking. 
I guess anything goes here.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Animal
text_block_list.text: Squeek Squeek!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow. There's even animals here too. 
…Hey there, you adorable thing. Pspspsp…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What an interesting world.
It's artificially made,
but it doesn't feel artificial.
A world that goes as far as one's
"imagination".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…I wonder where the god of this world has
journeyed.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What, it's over already? 
I wanted to be in there for a few more
hours.

In the end,
Stay Gold had her fill of fun until the
hours of operations ceased. Before we knew it,
night had come.
choice_data_list: The virtual world was quite fun, no?
The virtual world was quite fun, no?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
it really was.
I was surprised over and over again.
Are there other worlds in there?
I want to go there again.

—Well, there's… 
There was one thing I noticed.
text_block_list.name: Stay Gold

text_block_list.text:
If memory serves me right… the Uma-lator is
only for use in conjunction with training,
right?
text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Was that alright? 
Using it for nothing more than
entertainment?
choice_data_list: To be honest, we shouldn't have do...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That so? 
…So, what's the plan now?

Having said that,
I showed her the "Uma-lator Use Form". 
…The after use report could be filled out
however it seems.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Pft.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I get it now! 
You really like walking on thin ice!
choice_data_list: I'd wither away if I don't get sti...
I'd wither away if I don't get sti...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally. 
That's the truth right there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Welp, time to go write that report. 
So we can tread on that ice again next time,
right?
